about: The issue snapshot rtm_check reads offline, written by tools/method/make_rtm.py --refresh-issues: every open issue, every issue requirements.md cites, and every issue with a Requirement: or Control: line. Number, title, state, labels, milestone and the parsed ids only: never a body (POL-7), and a refresh whose titles would name a golfer writes nothing. requirement/control: null when the issue has no such line, ["none"] for "none".
